Hi Dana — great to hear from you, and glad the demo was useful.

I attached a short plan-comparison PDF that lays out three recommended paths:
1) Hosted Starter: pay-as-you-go hosted API (fastest setup)
2) Dedicated Reserve: reserved GPU capacity with committed throughput
3) Private VPC (3-region): customer-managed network + Private control plane

Notes specific to your asks:
- Upgrade path: you can start on Hosted and move to Dedicated or Private; model/version pins and routing policies stay the same so app changes are minimal.
- Observability: we can bundle 90d retention as an add-on; standard is 30d.
- Discounts: we typically provide term-based discounts for 12mo/24mo commits and a modest onboarding credit for new private deployments.

See attached: Redwood_Pricing_Options_Q2_v2.pdf (summary). I flagged this for pricing follow-up with Marissa and our pricing lead.

Propose: quick call Thursday to align on which path you want to evaluate first.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra

[rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai]

Dana

Hi Dana / Tom —

Thanks for the call last week and for outlining the procurement target. Per our discussion, attached is a concise custom quote and a draft SOW for the 3-region Private deployment and a hybrid evaluation path: Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private. Highlights below so procurement can attach to the PO: 

- Commercial: 12-month committed baseline across 3 regions. Offer: 18% off base usage + an additional Redwood credit equal to 6% of ARR earmarked for observability retention and premium support (effectively ~24% value to you when used).
- Bundle: 90d observability retention (vs standard 30d) included for the term. First 3 months of premium onboarding and support waived (onboarding credit).
- Billing & Payment: PO required, 30% upfront on Reserved/Dedicated/Private start. Standard T+C; SOC2 evidence + KMS integration support included in onboarding tasks.
- Upgrade path: Start on Hosted with a zero-downtime migration path. Model pins and routing policies preserved — app changes minimal.

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm the acceptance of the commercial terms above by EOD Tue so we can issue a formal quote PDF and SOW for signature.
2) I'll attach the PDF quote and SOW for procurement after confirmation.

Attachments: Redwood_Custom_Quote_DataSecure_20260328.pdf, SOW_Draft_DataSecure.docx
